She is the narrator of the video and shares her personal experiences and reasons for loving India. content_metadata.description: Ivana, the only character in the video, shares her love for India by discussing her personal experiences and reasons that have drawn her to the country. The video unfolds through various themes, from the richness of Indian culture to the warmth of its people, and the beauty of the landscape. Ivana's narrative is infused with personal anecdotes, humor, and genuine appreciation for the country.

qAndA.answer: Ivana is wearing an Indian kurta. She explains that she is saving it to wear when she returns to India because it is not commonly worn in the Netherlands. This detail highlights her appreciation for Indian culture.
qAndA.question: What is the clothing item Ivana is wearing in the video and why is it significant?

qAndA.answer: Ivana repeatedly expresses her love for paneer, a type of Indian cheese. Her strong preference for this dish underscores her deep appreciation for Indian cuisine.
qAndA.question: What specific Indian food does Ivana express a strong preference for, even going as far as to refer to it as an "addiction"?

qAndA.answer: Ivana shares a story about a man she met on the street who invited her into his home. This anecdote vividly illustrates the welcoming nature of many Indian people.
qAndA.question: Describe an instance where Ivana encountered generosity and hospitality from an Indian person.

qAndA.answer: Her number one reason is the hot weather. Viewers might be surprised because many people associate India with extreme heat and challenging climate conditions. However, Ivana explains that coming from a cold and rainy country, she finds the warmth of India incredibly comforting. This reveals her personal preferences and how they shape her experience of India.
qAndA.question: What is the number one reason Ivana loves India, and why might some viewers find this reason surprising?

qAndA.answer: Ivana learned about humbleness and real happiness, realizing that true happiness does not come from material possessions but rather from within. This insight demonstrates her personal growth and evolving perspective on life, influenced by her interactions with Indian people.
qAndA.question: What valuable life lesson did Ivana learn from interacting with Indian people?

youtube_description:
Why do I love India? I'm giving you 6 reasons but there are a hundred more. People are starting to ask me more and more why I love India so I decided to make a video giving my 6 most important reasons why I love India. 
Hope you enjoy this video but DON'T click the following link: http://bit.ly/1KKCs8V (you just might be stuck with me by subscribing)
If you're on a roll here's the playlist with all the India vlogs: http://bit.ly/2j8GD73 
NOTE: My vlogs are always uploaded 7 days later. 

DAILY TRAVEL ON I N S T A G R A M: http://instagram.com/iperkovic
DAILY TRAVEL ON T W I T T E R: http://twitter.com/ivanaperkovic
FACEBOOK: www.facebook.com/TravelVlogIv
SNAPCHAT: IPERKOVIC




SEND ME AN EMAIL: ivana@enterpriseme.nl

Travel Vlog Iv is a travel vlog channel. I'm Ivana, nice to meet you! I travel and make daily travel vlogs so you can travel with me. Subscribe if you like to travel! 

When I'm not traveling you can hang out with me in my home town Amsterdam. So if you always wanted to travel in Amsterdam this is the place to be to get an insight in the local life without actually having to travel. Enjoy!

FAQ's:

Q Where are you from?
A I am born in former Yugoslavia. Mom is Serbian, Dad is Bosnian. During the '90's war we came to the Netherlands and I got Dutch nationality. Have been living in Amsterdam for over 5 years.

Q How can you afford to travel so much?
A I saved for 3 years while working full time and now travel vlogging is my job. I work together with tourism agencies but also do some freelance work on the side.

Q What camera do you film with?
A Canon G7X

Q Why doesn't Stephan want to be on camera?
A Because he is an artist manager and feels artists should be in the spotlight. Way before he met me he already never featured in party pics or anything. 

Q Why do you usually travel alone?
A Because my friends have jobs with limited holidays, kids and partners. Also I really like exploring on my own.
